## TÜRKIYE — profile (page 230)

- **Header facts:** Region: Europe & Central Asia; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: IBRD; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 85.9 million; GNI: 1,574,034; Unit: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** **572,792**, **+12.3% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Start value (**2015**): **399,431**. End value (**2025**): **572,792**.  
  The line is roughly flat at the start, rises to an early bump around **≈2017**, falls back by **≈2019**, then increases gradually through **≈2022–24**, with a sharp rise in **2025**. The **peak year is 2025**.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**  
  - **Total external debt:** **572,792**
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed:** **196,161**
    - **Private nonguaranteed:** **210,877**
    - **Short-term:** **165,754**
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** **196,161**
    - **Multilateral:** **33,870**
    - **Bilateral:** **11,109**
    - **Private creditors:** **151,182**
  - **Multilateral:** **33,870**
    - **World Bank-IBRD:** **13,824**
    - **IMF-SDR allocations:** **7,582**
    - **Other multilateral:** **12,463**
  - **Bilateral:** **11,109**
    - **United Arab Emirates:** **3,540**
    - **Japan:** **2,473**
    - **Other bilateral:** **5,097**

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**  
  - **External debt / exports:** **142%**, **+6.7%**. Trend: fluctuates, with a spike around **≈2020**, then declines and edges up by **2025**.  
  - **External debt / GNI:** **36%**, **-4.3%**. Trend: rises mildly to a mid-period high around **≈2019**, then trends downward to **2025**.  
  - **Debt service / exports:** **25%**, **+7.5%**. Trend: rises sharply early, stays elevated, spikes around **≈2021**, drops, then recovers somewhat by **2025**.  
  - **Debt service / GNI:** **6%**, **-3.6%**. Trend: rises to a peak around **≈2021**, then declines and levels off by **2025**.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**  
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **11 yrs**; Grace period **4 yrs**; Interest rate **3.9%**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **6 yrs**; Grace period **4 yrs**; Interest rate **5.4%**

- **Notes/Source:**  
  Figure 2 includes **IMF credit and SDR allocations**.  
  Figure 3 shaded band shows the **25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries**.  
  **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
